cmd.data.export_step.desc: Saves the whole model or the selection as STEP AP214 or AP242: solids with exact planar, cylindrical, conical, spherical, toroidal and B-spline faces, other elements as planar faces, colours, one assembly node per level.
cmd.data.export_3mf.desc: Saves the whole model or the selection as 3MF for printing: one object per element, colours, units, and a check that every body is watertight.
mx.faceted: {fmt} saved: {path} ({exact} exact solids, {n} written as planar faces: {first})
